tei:div.tei:p: bka' brgyad gtor zlog nyin dang po la/ khyab bdag ston pa= mtha' phud/ brgya rdung 'bring po/ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gdangs chen tshig gnyis/ 'bebs gdangs chags med/ byin chen 'bebs gdangs rgyun 'jags/ de ting*/ rgyu ting gnyi+es gdangs/ yod med stong pa/ byang phyogs dkyil 'khor tshig gnyis/ spyan 'dren gdangs thung tshig bzhi rgyun chags/ sman mchod rgyun chags/ dwangs bsil snyog med= khrag 'thung rgyal po= rdo rje sgeg mo= bcas dma' mtho spel ma rgyun chags/ 'dzam bu'i gser 'khor= 'dod yon lnga= gdangs rgyun mthar/ gdug pa can rnams= mtha' phud/ rgyu gnyis rkyen sbyar= gdangs chen tshig gnyis/ bstod pa tshig bzhi gdangs thung rgyun chags/ snyen gdangs la/ zhi ba tshar gsum/ khro bo'i spyi sngags tshar gsum/ che mchog snyen pa tshar gsum/ dam can spyi gtor gdangs tshar gcig tsam/ tshogs/ rdo rje lta bu= rgyun bstar/ chos dbyings 'gyur med= tshig gnyis gdangs ring*/ chos kyi dbyings= tshig bzhi/ 140) dpal chen che mchog= tshig brgyad/ dgra bgegs gdug pa= tshig bzhi mtshams rol gnyis/ skong ba tshig bzhi lnga/ dang po phud kyi= mtha' phud/ skul pa mtha' phud/ chad tho tshig brgyad/ brtan ma tshig brgyad/ rta bro tshig brgyad/ bkra shis rgyun chags bcas/ ༈ nyin gnyis pa la/ brgya rdung chung ba/ rdo rje slob dpon= tshar gsum gdangs/ bdag nyid las kyi= mthar 'don/ bshags pa tshig gnyis/ thams cad snying po= 'jig rten khams= dbus phyogs mi 'gyur= tshig gnyis/ gdug pa can rnams= tshig gnyis sam bzhi gang mos/ 'khril ba'i mchog chen= la/ yang dag rtogs pa'i= gdangs sbyar/ zhi snyen tshar gcig che mchog tshar gcig rgyun chags/ phyogs bzhi bka' sdod= dang lnga tshar re/ tshar nang*/ bla med mchog gi= tshig gnyis/ skong ba tshig bzhi gcig smad las la/ skul pa tshig brgyad/ byin rlabs mchog rtsol= gdangs ring tshig bzhi/ mthu stobs dbang phyug= tshig bzhi gnyis 'bebs/ ma bcos spros bral=

tshig bcu gdangs thung*/ chos kyi dbyings las= 141) tshig bzhi/ drag sngags so lnga rgyun chags / nga ni sngags 'chang= tshig bzhi/ lhag ma tshig gnyis/ yab la bstabs so= tshig bzhi/ khrag 'phyar tshig bzhi re mar rim bzhin res mos chag med dgos/ dpal chen che mchog= tshig bcu gcig dal/ de man brel tsam/ rtsang*/ dpal chen khro rgyal= tshig drug nyin bzhin bstar chags/ rtsang phur rngam stabs= tshig brgyad/ man chod nyin bzhin res mos/ 'dab chags rgyal po= tshig bcu/ bar du rnga mtshams/ dbus kyi dpal chen= tshig dgu gdangs dang rta/ skul pa tshig bzhi/ brtan ma tshig bzhi bcas/ ༈ nyin gsum pa la/ khyab bdag stonapa= gdangs/ brgya rdung chung ba/ snang srid 'khor lo= tshig bzhi gsang mtshams gdangs/ de ting*/ rgyu ting*/ rdo rje pad+ma= spyan 'dren dbyangs ring tshig gnyis/ dbyangs thung tshig gnyis/ gdug pa can= rnams mthar 'don/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i= tshig bzhi/ khro bo spyi dril dang*/ mtshams bzhi/ drag sngags so lnga bcas tshar re/ skong ba tshig bzhi/ smad las 142) la/ skul pa tshig bcu drug byin rlabs mchog stsol= sho lo ka gsum la gzu dpang gdangs sam/ tshig bzhi gdangs/ gzhan lhug gang mos nyin bzhin bstar chags/ e yi tshogs kyi= tshig bcu gnyis/ dpal chen che mchog= gdangs/ nga ni che mchog= me mtshams gdangs kyis mthar dbyung*/ rang byung bstan pa= tshig bzhi la/ nga ni sngags 'chang= gdangs sbyar/ lhag ma mthar 'don/ snang zhing srid pas= tshig bzhi/ shar du yang dag gtor ma'i steng: gdangs dang 'don rta le tshan gnyis/ man chod de'i 'gres/ chad tho tshig brgyad/ rta bro tshig brgyad bcas/ ༈ nyin bzhi pa la/ brgya rdung 'bring po/ rdo rje slob dpon= tshar gcig bdag nyid thugs= nas/ 'bar ba'i lta stangs= byin 'bebs dbyangs ring tshig gnyis/ kun ting*/ gdug pa can rnams= tshig bzhi/ bde gshegs bka' yi= tshig bzhi/ zhi ba spyi dril phyogs bzhi/ bka' sdod bcas tshar re/ skong ba tshig bzhi can lnga/

skul pa tshig bcu drug khrag 'thung sku las= tshig lnga/ chos kyi dbyings las= tshig bzhi/ 143) bh+yo: nam mkha' lha yi rkang thang= tshig nyi shu/ lhag ma tshig gnyis/ dang po bh+yo yi mi gdab= gdangs dang 'don rta tshig bcu dgu skul tshig bzhi/ brtan ma tshig brgyad bcas/ ༈ nyin lnga pa la/ brgya rdung chung ba/ me mtshams gdangs tshig brgyad/ de ting*/ rgyu ting*/ gdug pa can= rnams mtha' phud/ gdod nas rang rig= gshin rje'i bar gdangs/ bstod pa gdangs chen tshig gnyis/ 'bebs gdangs tshig gnyis/ khro bo spyi dril/ mtshams bzhi drag sngags so lnga bcas tshar re/ skong ba tshig bzhi/ skul pa tshig bcu drug dam tshig chen po= tshig brgyad/ nga ni che mchog= tshig bcu drug me mtshams gdangs/ stong pa'i ye shes= tshig bzhi/ nga ni sngags 'chang= gdangs/ nyon cig 'chi bdag= mthar dbyung*/ tshar gnyis shar 'don/ chad tho tshig brgyad/ rta bro tshig brgyad bcas/ ༈ nyin drug pa la/ brgya rdung chung ba/ thugs las oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa e= gsang mtshams gdangs/ kun ting*/ hūm̐ las e yaṃ= e las nam mkha'= tshig gnyis/ 144) gdug pa can rnams= tshig bzhi/ zhi ba spyi dril/ phyogs bzhi/ bka' sdod/ skong ba tshig bzhi/ skul pa tshig bcu drug chos kyi dbyings las= tshig bzhi gdangs/ che mchog dpal dgu= nga ni sngags 'chang= tshig bzhi/ lhag ma mthar phud/ dpal gyi bka' sdod= tshig brgyad la dbus kyi dpal chen gtor mas dgab/ rgyu ni rin chen= tshig bzhi can gsum 'then/ skul pa tshig bzhi/ brtan ma tshig brgyad bcas/ ༈ nyin bdun par/ brgya rdung 'bring po/ mi bzad khro gtum= gsang mtshams gdangs tshig bzhi/ dbus phyogs mi 'gyur= nas/ lha skyed ma tshar bar thun gdangs la/ phur mthar mtshams rol/ gdug pa can rnams= tshig gnyis/ rgyu gnyis rkyen sbyar= bstod pa'i mgo bar gshin rje'i bar gdangs/ khro bo spyi dril dang*/ drag sngags so lnga snyen gdangs tshar gcig skong ba tshig bzhi/ skul pa tshig brgyad/ khrag 'thung sku las=

drag rdung 'bring po/ chos kyi dbyings las= tshig bzhi/ lhag ma mthar phud/ sgo dbye gdangs yongs rdzogs mthar dbyung*/ dgongs shig mkha' 'gro= mthar 'don/ 145) skul pa tshig bzhi gdangs/ chad tho tshig bzhi gdangs/ drag sngags so lnga chol rgyab can gcig gser skyems tshig bzhi can gcig gzu dpang gdangs/ brtan ma tshig bzhi'am brgyad/ rta bro tshig brgyad/ bkra shis tshig bzhi/ bkra shis 'khyil pa'i rol chen bcas bya'o/ dge'o// 146)
